comments.author: Egw
comments.body: Just wanted to bring this quest to the attention of wine-nanbaners. You can look for it in Hangzhou for the way back to Europe. Bananas can be bought in several SEA ports, and also in Guam and Hiva Oa (so it also works if you prefer to avoid SEA and return by way of the Pacific). It gives you 7 PO2s as reward, which depending on your alco trading, lux trading, handicrafts and cargo space, may be (more than) enough to refil for the next run.
